datasets.name: NOAA/NSIDC Climate Data Record of Passive Microwave Sea Ice Concentration, V6 (G02202)
datasets.whyBest: Gold-standard climate record with zero gaps across clouds/polar night, small file size (~150 KB/day NetCDF), ideal for training compact 2-level U-Nets on CPU/laptop.

datasets.role: 3D Satellite Surface Texture & Optical/Thermal Polar Imagery
datasets.name: NASA Earthdata GIBS (MODIS/VIIRS True Color & Blue Marble Next Generation) + Copernicus Sentinel-2
datasets.coverage: Antarctic Continent, Ice Shelves & Southern Ocean
datasets.access: Free public WMS/WMTS endpoints (no API key required)
datasets.whyBest: Provides open-access, legally redistributable polar satellite imagery with zero commercial API keys, fused with BedMachine DEM and NSIDC sea-ice concentration.

datasets.name: AMSR2 ASI (ARTIST Sea Ice) Passive Microwave 89 GHz Daily Grids
datasets.whyBest: 4× finer spatial resolution than SSMIS/CDR; resolves narrow coastal polynyas and fast-ice channels on the approach to Bharati (Prydz Bay) and Maitri.

datasets.name: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis on Single Levels (10m Wind & 2m Temp)
datasets.agency: Copernicus C3S / ECMWF / Google Cloud ARCO-ERA5
datasets.access: Free via Copernicus CDS API or AWS/GCP Public Zarr (`gs://gcp-public-data-arco-era5`)
datasets.whyBest: Adding `u10/v10` wind channels to the U-Net input tensor provides the strongest physical predictor for 3–7 day wind-driven sea-ice advection and polynya opening.

datasets.role: Satellite Sea-Ice Drift Vectors & Ocean Currents
datasets.name: OSI SAF / Copernicus Global Ocean & Sea Ice Drift (OSI-405-c / GLORYS12)
datasets.access: Free via Copernicus Marine Toolbox (`copernicusmarine`) & OSI SAF FTP/HTTPS
datasets.whyBest: Directly supplies observed ice motion vectors and Antarctic Coastal Current velocity for both U-Net advection channels and physical iceberg drift cones.

datasets.name: US National Ice Center (USNIC) & BYU SCP Antarctic Iceberg Database
datasets.agency: USNIC / Brigham Young University Microwave Earth Remote Sensing
datasets.resolution: Tabular Bergs (≥10 NM) & Small Bergs (Sentinel-1 SAR via CMEMS)
datasets.whyBest: Provides real historical and live positions of Southern Ocean tabular icebergs (A-, B-, C-, D-quadrants) to initialize the 7-day drift + uncertainty cone module.

datasets.role: 3D Land, Mountain Elevation, Grounded Ice-Shelf & Bathymetry Mask
datasets.name: MEaSUREs BedMachine Antarctica v3 (NSIDC-0756), REMA DEM & IBCSO v2
datasets.coverage: Antarctic Continent, Ice Shelves & Southern Ocean
datasets.whyBest: Supplies the 3D topographic elevation model (Prince Charles Mts, Wohlthat Mts, Framnes Mts, East Antarctic Ice Dome), floating ice shelves (Amery, Lazarev, West), and Southern Ocean bathymetry.
